hosted_verification_note: Verified locally via Vitest unit/component/adapter/i18n tests, TypeScript typecheck, Vite production build, isolated loopback fixture Playwright E2E, and a headless Chromium browser route-mock verification of /management/trading-pulse.
summary: Normalize snake_case and camelCase Trading Pulse card detail fields (by_status, by_stage, row_health_status_counts, degraded_runtime_ids, telemetry_coverage_count, metric_coverage with available_count/missing_count/missing_runtime_ids, worst_slippage_bps, baseline_comparison_count, by_baseline_status, missing_baseline_runtime_ids), summary/meta.coverage fields (telemetry_coverage_count, monitoring_coverage_count, paper_runtime_count, baseline_comparison_count, row_health_degraded_count, row_health_status_counts, missing_telemetry_runtime_ids, missing_monitoring_runtime_ids, missing_baseline_runtime_ids, degraded_runtime_ids, metric_coverage), and summary.retired_runtime_count in src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts without adding per-field snake_case fallbacks in _core.tsx; render excluded retired runtime count on the runtime coverage tile in both zh-TW and en-US when summary.retired_runtime_count is present while rendering nothing extra when absent; preserve dash rendering when coverage counts are genuinely absent.

acceptance_criteria.1_card_detail_fields_render_real_values: verified: Given the snake_case BFF payload, all six Trading Pulse cards render real values for by_status, by_stage, row_health_status_counts, degraded_runtime_ids, telemetry_coverage_count, metric_coverage (available_count/missing_count/missing_runtime_ids), worst_slippage_bps, baseline_comparison_count, by_baseline_status, and missing_baseline_runtime_ids instead of dashes
acceptance_criteria.2_data_coverage_tiles_and_absent_dash: verified: Data coverage tiles for telemetry (81/90), monitoring (79/88), and baseline (76/90) render counts merged from summary and meta.coverage instead of a dash when supplied by the BFF, and still render '—' when genuinely absent
acceptance_criteria.3_adapter_normalization_only: verified: Field normalization lives in src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts (normalizeTradingPulseCardDetails, normalizeTradingPulseMetricCoverageEntry, normalizeTradingPulseCoverage, normalizeTradingPulseSummary, normalizeTradingPulseMeta) accepting both camelCase and snake_case; src/management/pages/oversight/_core.tsx adds no new per-field snake_case fallbacks
acceptance_criteria.4_retired_runtime_count_display: verified: When summary.retired_runtime_count is present, the runtime tile appends 'Excluded retired: <count>' in en-US and '已排除已退役：<count>' in zh-TW; when absent, nothing extra renders
acceptance_criteria.5_page_and_adapter_tests: verified: src/management/pages/oversight/TradingPulsePage.test.tsx renders a payload with exact snake_case BFF field names and asserts all rendered card detail lines, coverage tiles, absent-value dashes, and retired_runtime_count in en-US and zh-TW; src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/management.test.ts covers both snake_case and camelCase inputs
acceptance_criteria.6_live_only_states_and_existing_suites_g: verified: Live-only unavailable and loading states on TradingPulsePage are unchanged, and existing Vitest suites plus isolated loopback fixture Playwright E2E specs pass without new skips or weakened assertions
